<repaired_code>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    double target = (double)x / y;
    long long best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
    double min_diff = 1e18;
    
    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        // Find the best numerator a for this denominator b
        long long a = (long long)round(target * b);
        
        // Check floor and ceil to be safe
        vector<long long> candidates = {a};
        if (a > 0) candidates.push_back(a - 1);
        candidates.push_back(a + 1);
        
        for (long long cand : candidates) {
            if (cand < 0) continue;
            double diff = fabs((double)cand / b - target);
            if (diff < min_diff - 1e-12 || 
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b < best_b) ||
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b == best_b && cand < best_a)) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_a = cand;
                best_b = b;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << best_a << '/' << best_b << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
</repaired_code>
